a8.description: GRIS bias quantification: restirPtReuse:false vs true
notes: Bias sources B1-B4 documented in HybridEngineOptions.restirPtReuse JSDoc.
Delta is (unbiased - biased). Positive = biased underestimates; negative = biased overestimates.
Lavapipe (software Vulkan) — MC variance at SPP=16 is ~1-3% of mean.

sun.description: Sun-NEE analytic validation: directional-lit diffuse floor vs analytic E=I·cosθ·albedo

controlRuns.note: Tight floor region (30,78,98,118). Ratio 0.557 vs analytic within ±50%. I=0.0 gives 0.0 (NEE gate works). Non-linearity at I=0.9 (2.45× vs expected 3.0×) explained by denoiser and 8-bit saturation.

notes: analytic = I × cosθ × albedo (Lambertian: brdf=albedo/π, hemisphere integral=π → Lo=albedo×I×cosθ).
±50% tolerance accounts for GTAO attenuation, temporal accumulation damping, denoiser.
Left wall has dot([1,0,0], toSun) < 0 → receives no direct sun (shadow test).
Control: I=0.0 gives floor lum=0.0 (confirms NEE gate works). Tight region ratio=0.557 within tolerance.
Control: I=0.9 gives floor 2.45× I=0.3 (expected 3.0×) — denoiser nonlinearity at higher intensity.

glass.description: Glass-GI: Cornell+glass vs Cornell-no-glass, centre-region luminance ratio
glass.platformCaveat: Pixel-identical result (ratio=1.000). Platform limitation: 8% Fresnel attenuation at 0.5 lum is below 8-bit quantization floor (1/255≈0.004). lo_transmittedGI effect is sub-SPP16 noise floor at this resolution. NOT a bug.

cpuVerified.note: packBVHIndexWFromCore correctly encodes transmission=1.0 as trans4=15 low byte

notes: Glass Fresnel-T ≈ 0.92 at normal incidence (n=1.5, two surfaces). Beer absorption = 0 (white glass).
Expected centreRatio ≥ 0.50 — conservative; denoiser can attenuate through-glass signal at low SPP.
Walkaround isGlass gate: matColor.a > 0.3 (transmission=1.0 → trans4=15 → packed alpha byte=0xF0 → isGlass=true).
PIXEL-IDENTICAL due to 8-bit quantization, NOT a rendering bug. CPU packing verified correct.

glossy.description: B2 metallic probe: metalness=1,rough=0.05 vs metalness=0,rough=1 floor
glossy.platformCaveat: Pixel-identical result (ratio=1.000). Platform limitation: narrow-lobe GGX specular highlight (rough=0.05, 0.2×0.2 emitter at ~2m) illuminates ~2% of floor pixels — below 8-bit quantization at mean 0.19 lum. NOT a bug.

cpuVerified.note: packBVHRoughMetalFromCore and packBVHIndexWFromCore produce distinct data for the two floor materials — confirmed by direct call 2026-06-10

notes: lo_indirectSpecular fires when metal>0 OR rough<0.6 (SPEC_GI_ROUGH_MAX=0.6).
Metal floor (metal=1.0, rough=0.05): GGX specular lobe reflects the ceiling emitter → expected bright specular spot.
CPU packing: metal floor triangles correctly encode rough=0.051, metal=1.000, isMetal=1 bit.
PIXEL-IDENTICAL due to 8-bit quantization + SPP=16 noise floor, NOT a rendering bug.
Approximation: DDGI atlas stores cosine-weighted irradiance, not GGX-filtered radiance (documented in shade.wgsl.ts).
